com.sun.corba.se.impl.protocol

类 RequestDispatcherRegistryImpl

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.corba.se.impl.protocol.RequestDispatcherRegistryImpl
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    RequestDispatcherRegistry

    public class RequestDispatcherRegistryImpl
extends Object
implements RequestDispatcherRegistry
    This is a registry of all subcontract ID dependent objects. This includes: LocalClientRequestDispatcherFactory, ClientRequestDispatcher, ServerSubcontract, and ObjectAdapterFactory.
